title: VEHICLE DEEP-DIVE! Copi Cafe Episode 58 | Cornucopias
description:
Welcome to episode 58 of COPICafe! In this episode, Rob and Josh kick things off by providing a review of the OG Mint and share valuable insights about the highly anticipated upcoming T3 Sale.

They then shift gears to discuss the latest advancements in the Desktop launcher, exciting updates in the Racing Game, and share new information about Characters and Avatars.

Next up special guest appearance, taking you on a DEEP DIVE into the impressive lineup of Vehicles and Classes. 

To wrap things up, they drop a juicy leak, then dedicate time to answer some burning Community Questions.

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items.
